title: Settings
disconnect_confirm: Disconnect the store? Its products, orders and campaign history are removed from Hontrio, and the autopilot stops managing its campaigns. Campaigns already running in Google Ads keep running, so pause them first in Campaigns if you no longer want them.
tutorial_wp_steps: 1. Open the WordPress dashboard (wp-admin),2. WooCommerce → Settings → Advanced → REST API,3. Add a key with “Read” permission,4. Copy the Consumer Key and Consumer Secret
security_desc: Store keys and Google access are stored encrypted. When you change or reset your password, every other session of the account is signed out.
pref_email_desc: Emails when the safety stop pauses a campaign, when a protective action fails or Google access is lost, and when new proposals await your approval (at most one a day per store).
error_save: We couldn't save. Please try again.
conn_ok_full: Connection successful! The store is reachable.
conn_cant_connect: We couldn't connect. Check the address and that the site is online.
error_connect: We couldn't connect the store. Please try again.
error_disconnect: We couldn't disconnect the store. Please try again.
danger_zone_desc: The actions below are permanent and cannot be undone.
how_get_api_keys: How do I get API keys?
active_now_browser: Active now, in a web browser
add_store_hint: You can link several stores. The pages show the active store's data, which you can switch here or from the header.
error_switch_store: We couldn't switch the active store.
merchant_desc: The catalog your Shopping ads are built from. Hontrio reads the product statuses and the market reports, without changing your feed.
merchant_none: We don't know the store's Merchant Center account yet. Check the Google Ads account in Campaigns or enter the Merchant Center ID.
merchant_id_invalid: The Merchant Center ID has digits only.
merchant_sync_failed: Syncing with Merchant Center failed. Try again.
merchant_google_missing: Connect your Google account so Hontrio can read Merchant Center.
merchant_never: Not synced yet. The sync runs automatically, usually within an hour, or now with the button.
profile_info_desc: Your name and picture appear in the platform menu. The email is the one you sign in with.
language_hint: Changes right away, across your account.
delete_account_desc: Deletes the account, the linked stores and all their data from Hontrio, and withdraws Hontrio's access to Google, Edinio and Shopify.
section_add_store_desc: Edinio links in one click and Shopify is approved from your store. WooCommerce, Gomag and MerchantPro link with a read-only key, and OpenCart with the Hontrio extension.
section_google_desc: The Google Ads account your campaigns run in and the Merchant Center Google takes your products from.
pw_footer: At least 8 characters. A longer password is safer. Signed up with Google? Set a password with “Forgot password” on the sign-in page.
load_error_profile: We couldn't load your profile. What you see below may be incomplete.
load_error_stores: We couldn't load your stores, but they are still connected. Try again in a moment.
export_desc: A copy of everything Hontrio keeps about your account, in a JSON file.
export_contents: Profile, stores (without access keys), products, orders, campaigns, the autopilot's proposals and log, notifications and support tickets.
export_failed: We couldn't prepare the file. Please try again.
delete_campaigns_warning: The campaigns Hontrio started stay in your Google Ads account and keep spending the budget, but Hontrio no longer manages them. If you no longer want them, pause them first.
delete_google_hint: Signed up with Google and have no password? Leave the field empty. It works if you signed in with Google in the last 10 minutes.
delete_password_required: Enter your password to confirm the deletion.
delete_reauth_google: For your safety, sign out and sign in again with Google, then delete the account within 10 minutes.
delete_failed: The deletion stopped before the end. Please try again, and if it keeps failing, write to us.
delete_admin_blocked: An admin account can't be deleted from here. Another admin must first remove your admin role.
disconnect_confirm_remove: Disconnect the store? Hontrio permanently deletes the campaigns it created for it from Google Ads, with their budgets, and its products, orders and campaign history are removed from Hontrio.
delete_campaigns_warning_remove: The campaigns created by Hontrio are permanently deleted from your Google Ads account together with your account and can't be started again. Your other campaigns stay as they are.
